messages:
Maya: Quick triage — finalizing SRD for structured output launch. Need to confirm acceptance criteria for function/tool calling schema validation + fallback. Customer asks about partial outputs and unknown tool responses.

Sam: Can you paste the current acceptance checklist? I saw the draft but not sure about error codes.

Maya: Pasted checklist: 1) strict schema validation pass/fail 2) deterministic fallback path 3) telemetry for schema failures 4) contract version negotiation 5) clear consumer-facing error messages. Are these sufficient?

Leo: Add: timeouts from tool calls must map to a well-defined response type: {status: 'tool_timeout', fallback_used: true/false}. Also define retry window.

Priya: ML note — when model outputs extra fields, we should accept forward-compatible fields (ignore unknown) unless they conflict with required keys. We need unit tests for 'extra keys' vs 'type mismatch'.

Ashley: Customer-facing: customers want 2 things — (a) explicit guarantee on no-silent-degradation (if fallback used, include header / response flag) (b) observable metric and sample payloads when fallback triggered.

Sam: Proposed API error payload: ```json
{
  "error_code":"SCHEMA_MISMATCH",
  "message":"Output did not match contract",
  "schema_path":"/outputs/items/0/name",
  "received_type":"string",
  "expected":"object",
  "fallback":"model-v2-lite"
}
```

Leo: Runtime implementation note: prefer soft-validate on first pass (warn + accept) for canary tenants, hard-validate for GA. Need config per-route + per-tenant.

Priya: Edge cases to capture: a) model emits non-JSON (HTML) b) truncated JSON c) deeply nested arrays cause OOM. Add guardrails: max_depth, max_array_length, validate-stream-chunks.

Sam: Agree. For truncated streams we should attempt repair if we can detect a trailing 'null' or '}' else fail-fast and call fallback.

Maya: Action items: Sam -> update PRD acceptance with error payload example + telemetry fields. Leo -> runtime feature flag + per-route config. Priya -> tests for extra keys, type mismatch, truncated streams. Ashley -> draft customer comms about fallback indicators. I'll consolidate into PRD by EOD Friday.

deploy-bot: Note: added PRD-456 task to product board (https://board/redwood/PRD-456) :white_check_mark:

Sam: Quick Q: what's the rollout gating? GA requires <1% fallback rate on 10K requests and no severity-1 incidents for 2 weeks.

Maya: Yes that's the launch gate. Also add SLA wording for Dedicated customers.

Priya: I'll add unit tests and a small golden dataset for evals.

Maya: Thanks everyone. We'll sync tomorrow 10am to review PRD updates. :rocket:
